svg.title: Darkroom assembly sheet
svg.desc: Exploded view of the Darkroom cube with an assembled inset and an electronics detail, drawn from cad/darkroom.scad in one parallel projection. Not to scale.

g.text: A one-piece body and one front-loaded sled. One parallel projection of cad/darkroom.scad (v0.4); not to scale.
A EXPLODED · LOADED SLED OUT THROUGH THE OPEN FRONT
B ELECTRONICS · ILLUSTRATIVE SPACING, COLLAPSES TO THE CAD POSITIONS
front plate + floor + rails + rear bulkhead,
low-head, flush; heads only in CAD
glass in a plate pocket, PCB behind; fit
12 mm switches on 16 mm carrier boards
placeholder board; USB link to the Pi not
battery board under the Pi; thickness
white 1.2 mm shelf on the sled rails
two 5 mm LEDs on a breakout
Concept geometry from cad/darkroom.scad (v0.4); not a fabrication drawing or a confirmed build. The microSD reader is a placeholder board; display and PiSugar fit,
